item.title: Netanyahu says Israel will intensify strikes against Hezbollah
item.description: The Israeli military hits targets in eastern Lebanon after the prime minister announces further strikes.

item.title: More than 1.5m foreign pilgrims begin Hajj despite Iran war fears
item.description: Saudi Arabia says that is 11,000 more than the number of Muslims who travelled to the Gulf kingdom last year.

item.title: US launches new strikes on Iran, targeting missile sites and boats
item.description: US Central Command says the strikes were taken in "self-defence", while Iran reports it downed a US drone that entered its airspace.

item.title: Russia threatens more Kyiv strikes and tells foreign nationals to leave
item.description: It comes after the Ukrainian capital suffered one of the biggest aerial assaults of the war overnight on Saturday.
